raw_recipe.headline: Simply White Bread II
raw_recipe.description: A really simple, good tasting, low sodium white bread that is very light and lower in fat than many other white breads! Works well on delay cycle so you can have it ready when you are ready to eat.
raw_recipe.name: Simply White Bread II

recipeInstructions.text: Place ingredients in the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Select cycle; press Start.

review.reviewBody: What a pleasant surprise this was! I have my standard recipe for white bread and am very resistant to change, so I was tempted not to use the full amount of honey in this recipe as I thought it would be too sweet. In fairness to the recipe I "braved it" and added the full 2 tablespoons. Since I use yeast from the jar, I just measured out 1-1/2 teaspoons. Fragrant, soft and tender, this bread has the perfect balance of sweet and salty, though it is neither. Great bread for toast, sandwiches, or even on it's own with butter and jam!

Very good white bread. Slices nicely without crumbling. One thing I did find out on my last batch...I used 1/2 whole wheat flour and 1/2 all purpose flour with 3 tsp of gluten added, changed it to 18 servings like another reviewer to make a 2 lb loaf and it rose too much and not only hit the top of the lid, but overflowed. I took it out of the bread machine and separated the dough into 2 and placed in greased loaf pans and baked at 350 for 25 min and they came out great. I think from now on I will use the 18 servings adjustment and use the dough cycle on the bread machine and bake in the oven. Made great grilled cheese sandwiches and pb and j's. Definitely going into my favorites.

This bread is great!!! I was having a hard time finding bread in the stores a few weeks ago, so I had to break out my bread machine and found this recipe. I used the dough cycle then baked in the oven at 350 for a little over 30 minutes because my bread machine bakes loaves in an awkward “block shape”. This bread worked perfect for sandwiches and for grilled cheeses. Although bread is available in stores again, I haven’t bought a single loaf since. We’re hooked on this bread now. Super easy, too.

I've tried many different homemade bread recipes of different types. This recipe, by far, is the best! Approved by all 5 children and husband. I have made it 3 times and changed a few things. First I set it to 18 servings for a nice big loaf. I added 6 tsp wheat gluten & reduced the sugar in half. I use the dough cycle on the bread machine and it rises all the way to the top and hits the glass! I then put it in the oven at 360 degrees for 25-30 mins. It doesn't crumble, I cut it with a bread knife. Great for eating alone with butter and jelly, sandwiches, french toast, and different spreads. Our absolute FAVORITE!!! I made two loaves today and between the 6 of us, they are gone by the end of the day. I plan on making this everyday from here on out.

I like the simplicity of the recipe. I have made on a few time in the bread makers,,but have also converted to a mixer/oven recipe. Both work well and give a nice fluffy slice.. But I have found that depending on the day I have to add up to 1TBSP more water ( maybe humidity level, who knows) .
This last time , I experimented by shaping and cooking as buns, which also worked well
A keeper recipe for me that I can use either in a bread machine..or the oven which I do prefer

This bread is delicious . I made it as directed and used peanut oil. The smell will drive you crazy as it is cooking. It is soft and yummy. I had no problem making sandwiches of any kind even grilled cheese. It was a hit in my home!! Just made my second loaf today. I did had to add about a teaspoon of extra water. i saw some of the flour was not gathering to the ball in the dough cycle knead. I added a tablespoon on top of the flour that wasn't adhering to the ball. The flour then got right into the ball on the knead. Bread dough is like that some days you need less water some days more , some days none. I find the honey gives the bread just a hint of sweetness, which I like . Great recipe , will be my go for white bread . I have made so tried so many bread recipes . No more searching for a great white bread recipe!!! Thanks!

EXECLLENT easy bread to make. I used 1 tabsp marg and 1 of oil melted in the hot water and added a tabsp milk powder to the four. In place of baking in machine I made dough and baked in oven. I also used it for mini rolls. Will make larger rolls next time. Any which way this is a winner of a recipe

This bread is SO EASY to make and tastes great. I used my electric knife to cut and it didn't crumble-every slice was shaped nicely. I used this recipe and added another tablespoon (1/4 c. total) of honey to make "sweetrolls" in which rolled out, sprinkled with melted butter, cinnamon & sugar, and raisins) rolled them up and sliced, then baked in the oven and frosted. They were amazing! I recommend it, especially to moms with young ones (6 & 2) that like to help "cook"...I don't think you can make this bread and have it turn out bad!

Roughly one and a quarter parts liquid to three parts flour? No, no, no...a hydration in the low 40's is way, way too low. It's no wonder everyone gets a tight crumb! Hydration should be around 55%-65%. Sure enough, I ended up adding around .5 of a cup of water while the machine was kneading because the dough was too dry and kept "knocking." This additional water didn't affect the tight crumb. Also, .25 oz. of yeast is roughly 2 1/4 tsp.

This a good simple recipe for white bread. Don't forget to let the loaf cool before slicing or it'll be gummy. Enjoy!

Really good and it doesn't crumble when sliced. I used 2 c. white whole wheat flour, 1 c. AP flour, I used kosher salt and added 2 T. buttermilk powder. UPDATE: I bake alot of bread and this one has become a favorite. I now use melted butter instead of oil. I don't have a bread machine so I just proof my yeast and mix it up. Very good bread.

This is now my new all the time white bread recipe. So easy I love it. The family likes the bread in a lofe shape so I use the dough cycle, and bake at 350 for 30 min. checking at 25min. to be safe. I forgot the salt and DH did not notice so I now skip it all the time. I use EVOO in place of the vegetable oil. It seems healther to me. All I can say is don't let the short list of ingredients stop you this is good bread, nice smooth texture, toast up well and holds up to PB & J. brush the crust with butter and it wont get hard. Thank you LJSS for a wonderfull recipe.

Excellent recipe, very simple. I substituted sugar for the honey. Turned out fantastic. This recipe will very easy to modify by adding cheese for cheese bread etc. Great base bread recipe to experiment with.
No changes. Superb loaf. Thanks for recipe.

So easy and so yummy. I set the bread machine on dough cycle. After that, I remove it, shape it into a loaf on a lightly floured surface, put it in a greased 9" loaf pan, and let it rise again. 350-degree oven for about 30 minutes. I find cooking it in the oven makes the texture lighter. I like the fact that it doesn't ask for powdered milk like some of the bread recipes do. I never have any on hand. This recipe also works good with fast acting yeast. Thanks for the delicious recipe.
Excellent!! I followed the recipe exactly as written and wouldn't change a thing! perfect texture and great taste!
Very good recipe.
I added a tbls of Blue Chip Bakers dough enhancer and it came out great.

I was buying Sara Lee “light” bread for my weight watchers plan... and it didn’t have any mold a month later... I don’t see how that is healthy... Then I found this recipe and have made it several times. It’s perfect every time and delicious! And I know it’s so much healthier for my family! I’ve used agave instead of honey and evoo instead of veg oil. It’s just a perfect quick bread!
I made this recipe and it was fabulous
I made it this morning and it fell. I made it again and it fell! I followed the recipe exactly.
